scope: Corollary 4.3 (Conversion of twisted differentials) of the manuscript “Invariant anticanonical indices and conversion of twisted differentials” (preprints/Invariant-anticanonical-indices-and-conversion-of-twisted-differentials-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 068 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c40b47629aa1aa95), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let S be smooth connected projective with smoothly semipositive L = −KS. If, for one fixed p ≥ 0, H0 (S, Ωp S ⊗ OS(mL)) ̸= 0 for arbitrarily large positive integers m, then some positive multiple of L has a nonzero section.
